Total sales out of store expressed in Danish Krone (DKK). Consumer retail price including VAT (point-of-sale scanner data). This is the TOTAL — promo + non-promo combined. NULL = no data for this market/product/period combination.
Total sales out of store expressed in litres. Includes both promo and non-promo volume. NULL = no data for this combination.
Total sales out of store expressed in consumer purchase units (individual packs / bottles / cans as scanned at checkout). Includes both promo and non-promo. NULL = no data.

Value of sales (DKK) made on any type of promotion (TPR, display, feature, or any combination). Subset of sales_value: total = promo + non-promo. NOT applicable in Total Market incl Hard Discount (Lidl is cash-slip only). A small number of fact rows show promo slightly exceeding total due to rounding (<1,000 DKK); cap with MIN(promo, total) when displaying. NULL = promo not tracked for this combination.
Volume in litres sold on any type of promotion. Subset of sales_in_liters. NULL = promo not tracked. Not applicable in Total Market incl Hard Discount.
Units sold on any type of promotion. Subset of sales_units. NULL = promo not tracked. Not applicable in Total Market incl Hard Discount.
Units sold specifically on Temporary Price Reduction (TPR). TPR is a subset of 'any promo'. NULL = TPR not tracked.

Modeled value sales (DKK) that would have occurred in the absence of any promotions, calculated using Nielsen's proprietary baseline model. Includes non-promoted actual sales plus estimated sales that would have happened without promo support. CAN exceed actual sales_value when promotions had a negative incremental effect. Relationship: incremental_value = sales_value - baseline_sales_value. NULL = baseline not modeled for this combination (e.g. promo not tracked in this market).
Modeled volume in litres that would have occurred without promotions. Same baseline-model logic as baseline_sales_value. NULL = not modeled.
Modeled units that would have occurred without promotions. NULL = not modeled.

Baseline value sales (DKK) attributed specifically to the promoted portion. Used together with sales_value_any_promo to calculate promotional efficiency (PEI = Promotional Efficiency Index). NULL = not modeled.
Baseline volume in litres for the promoted portion. NULL = not modeled.
Baseline units for the promoted portion. NULL = not modeled.

Average WEEKLY percentage of stores where the product was sold for the chosen period, stored as a fraction 0-1 (multiply by 100 for %). Measures physical availability regardless of store size. Example: 0.45 means the product was sold in 45% of stores on average per week. NULL = not measured (e.g. aggregate product hierarchy levels, or cash-slip markets like Lidl).

Percentage of stores that sold the selected product at ANY point during the entire selected period (not weekly average), stored as a fraction 0-1. Higher than numeric_distribution because a store only needs to sell once in the period to count. NULL = not measured.

Average WEEKLY percentage of total CATEGORY TURNOVER (value sales) accounted for by stores that sold the selected product, ACV-weighted (All Commodity Volume). Stored as a fraction 0-1. Example: 0.85 = stores carrying this product represent 85% of category sales. More meaningful than numeric distribution because it weights by store importance. NOT additive across products. ~16.7% of CSD fact rows are NULL (aggregate levels, cash-slip markets like Lidl, or new products mid-period).

Percentage of total category turnover accounted for by stores that sold the selected product at ANY point during the entire period, stored as a fraction 0-1. Reach version: any single sale in the period qualifies the store. Always >= weighted_distribution. NULL = not measured.

Total Distribution Points (TDP). Sum of weighted distribution across all items within a brand/product group that were sold at any point during the period (reach). Measures BREADTH of assortment weighted by store importance. Example: a brand with 5 SKUs each at 0.80 weighted-distribution-reach has TDP ~4.0. NOT a percentage and NOT bounded by 1 — do NOT multiply by 100. NULL = not measured.

Number of distinct UPC items (SKUs) within the selected product group that were sold at any point during the period (reach). Measures assortment BREADTH. Only meaningful at aggregate product levels (brand, manufacturer); NULL at the UPC level.

Average number of stores in the universe that sold the product at any point during the period. Reach-based: a store counts if it sold at least once. Compare against universe_number_of_stores to derive % distribution.

Total number of physical stores in the selected market universe. Market-level attribute, NOT product-specific — same value for all products within a given market. NULL = not available for this market.
Average number of items (SKUs) a brand/manufacturer/segment has per store, computed across stores that carry at least one item. Measures DEPTH of assortment per store.

Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product ON PROMOTION in the period. Subset of weighted_distribution. NULL = promo not tracked. Not applicable in Total Market incl Hard Discount.

Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product with BOTH display AND feature (in-store flyer/ad) simultaneously. The strongest promotional signal. NULL = not tracked.
Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product with display only (without accompanying feature advertising). NULL = not tracked.
Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product with feature/flyer only (without accompanying secondary display). NULL = not tracked.
Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that promoted the product with any in-store FEATURE/FLYER (with or without accompanying display). NULL = not tracked.

Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product on ANY secondary display (endcap, floor stand, dump bin, pallet, etc.) in the period. NULL = display not tracked.

Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product on Temporary Price Reduction (TPR) in the period. TPR = any price cut from regular shelf price. Subset of promotional distribution. NULL = TPR not tracked.

Foreign key to the Product dimension. Joins facts to product metadata. Never NULL.

Total sales out of store expressed in Danish Krone (DKK). Consumer retail price including VAT (point-of-sale scanner data). This is the TOTAL — promo + non-promo combined. NULL = no data for this market/product/period combination.
Total sales out of store expressed in litres. Includes both promo and non-promo volume. NULL = no data for this combination.
Total sales out of store expressed in consumer purchase units (individual packs / bottles / cans as scanned at checkout). Includes both promo and non-promo. NULL = no data.

Modeled value sales (DKK) that would have occurred in the absence of any promotions, calculated using Nielsen's proprietary baseline model. Includes non-promoted actual sales plus estimated sales that would have happened without promo support. CAN exceed actual sales_value when promotions had a negative incremental effect. Relationship: incremental_value = sales_value - baseline_sales_value. NULL = baseline not modeled for this combination (e.g. promo not tracked in this market).
Modeled volume in litres that would have occurred without promotions. Same baseline-model logic as baseline_sales_value. NULL = not modeled.
Modeled units that would have occurred without promotions. NULL = not modeled.

Baseline value sales (DKK) attributed specifically to the promoted portion. Used together with sales_value_any_promo to calculate promotional efficiency (PEI = Promotional Efficiency Index). NULL = not modeled.
Baseline volume in litres for the promoted portion. NULL = not modeled.
Baseline units for the promoted portion. NULL = not modeled.

Value of sales (DKK) made on any type of promotion (TPR, display, feature, or any combination). Subset of sales_value: total = promo + non-promo. NOT applicable in Total Market incl Hard Discount (Lidl is cash-slip only). A small number of fact rows show promo slightly exceeding total due to rounding (<1,000 DKK); cap with MIN(promo, total) when displaying. NULL = promo not tracked for this combination.
Volume in litres sold on any type of promotion. Subset of sales_in_liters. NULL = promo not tracked. Not applicable in Total Market incl Hard Discount.
Units sold specifically on Temporary Price Reduction (TPR). TPR is a subset of 'any promo'. NULL = TPR not tracked.

Average WEEKLY percentage of stores where the product was sold for the chosen period, stored as a fraction 0-1 (multiply by 100 for %). Measures physical availability regardless of store size. Example: 0.45 means the product was sold in 45% of stores on average per week. NULL = not measured (e.g. aggregate product hierarchy levels, or cash-slip markets like Lidl).

Percentage of stores that sold the selected product at ANY point during the entire selected period (not weekly average), stored as a fraction 0-1. Higher than numeric_distribution because a store only needs to sell once in the period to count. NULL = not measured.

Average WEEKLY percentage of total CATEGORY TURNOVER (value sales) accounted for by stores that sold the selected product, ACV-weighted (All Commodity Volume). Stored as a fraction 0-1. Example: 0.85 = stores carrying this product represent 85% of category sales. More meaningful than numeric distribution because it weights by store importance. NOT additive across products. ~16.7% of CSD fact rows are NULL (aggregate levels, cash-slip markets like Lidl, or new products mid-period).

Percentage of total category turnover accounted for by stores that sold the selected product at ANY point during the entire period, stored as a fraction 0-1. Reach version: any single sale in the period qualifies the store. Always >= weighted_distribution. NULL = not measured.

Total Distribution Points (TDP). Sum of weighted distribution across all items within a brand/product group that were sold at any point during the period (reach). Measures BREADTH of assortment weighted by store importance. Example: a brand with 5 SKUs each at 0.80 weighted-distribution-reach has TDP ~4.0. NOT a percentage and NOT bounded by 1 — do NOT multiply by 100. NULL = not measured.

Number of distinct UPC items (SKUs) within the selected product group that were sold at any point during the period (reach). Measures assortment BREADTH. Only meaningful at aggregate product levels (brand, manufacturer); NULL at the UPC level.

Average number of stores in the universe that sold the product at any point during the period. Reach-based: a store counts if it sold at least once. Compare against universe_number_of_stores to derive % distribution.

Total number of physical stores in the selected market universe. Market-level attribute, NOT product-specific — same value for all products within a given market. NULL = not available for this market.
Average number of items (SKUs) a brand/manufacturer/segment has per store, computed across stores that carry at least one item. Measures DEPTH of assortment per store.

Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product ON PROMOTION in the period. Subset of weighted_distribution. NULL = promo not tracked. Not applicable in Total Market incl Hard Discount.

Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product with BOTH display AND feature (in-store flyer/ad) simultaneously. The strongest promotional signal. NULL = not tracked.
Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product with display only (without accompanying feature advertising). NULL = not tracked.
Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product with feature/flyer only (without accompanying secondary display). NULL = not tracked.
Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that promoted the product with any in-store FEATURE/FLYER (with or without accompanying display). NULL = not tracked.

Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product on ANY secondary display (endcap, floor stand, dump bin, pallet, etc.) in the period. NULL = display not tracked.

Percentage of category turnover (fraction 0-1) accounted for by stores that sold the product on Temporary Price Reduction (TPR) in the period. TPR = any price cut from regular shelf price. Subset of promotional distribution. NULL = TPR not tracked.

Top-level classification for the RTD dataset, distinguishing RTD (ready-to-drink) cocktails from cider. Equivalent to a 'category' label in this dataset.

Sub-brand grouping below brand in the product hierarchy. Distinguishes brand extensions and line variants.

Quantity descriptor for the multipack (e.g. number of consumer units in the pack). Stored as text.

Royal Unibrew internal segment classification (RTD dataset). RU-defined segmentation that may differ from Nielsen's standard segment.
Flag indicating whether the product is certified organic. Values are typically 'YES'/'NO' or category-specific labels.
Royal Unibrew internal packaging grouping (RUB = Royal Unibrew internal classification).
Sugar content classification: regular (full sugar) vs. light/diet/zero (RTD dataset).
RTD/cider classification with the DRINKS/COCKTAILS subsegment excluded. Useful for analyzing pure cider performance without RTD cocktail noise.
Flag indicating whether the product is a retailer private label (e.g. Coop's 365, REMA 1000 own brand) versus a branded manufacturer product.

Dedup key within a hierarchy level. At level 1 (category) there are typically multiple rows representing different total cuts of the category — ALWAYS filter to product_hierarchy_number = '1' for the canonical category total. At other levels typically '1'. Never NULL.

Depth level of the product in the hierarchy. Level 1 = category total, Level 2 = manufacturer/corporation, Level 3 = brand, ... Level 10 = individual UPC/SKU. CRITICAL for avoiding double-counting: never sum metrics across hierarchy levels. Never NULL.

Human-readable name of the hierarchy level. Values vary by category: CSD uses 'CSD', 'MANUFACTURER', 'BRAND', 'RU SUBBRAND', 'RU VARIANT', 'UPC'. Beer uses similar labels. Use this column to filter to the desired aggregation level (e.g. WHERE product_hierarchy_level_name = 'BRAND'). Never NULL.
Manufacturer of the product as classified by Nielsen. One level below the corporation grouping in the standard Nielsen product hierarchy.
